## Welcome to PPADEM

[About the Project]{.ppadem-pill}

PPADEM works with political parties, electoral institutions, and civil society across Africa to support democratic resilience and political integrity.

## Workstreams Overview

|:---|:---|:---|
| **01. Party Finance** | Governance | Transparency & campaign accountability |

| **03. Civic Engagement** | Inclusion | Youth & women participation in politics |

## Code & Data Analysis

```r
# Visualising party competition indicators
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(party_data, aes(x = year, y = competitiveness, color = region)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#990000", "#298c8c", "#f1a226")) +
  theme_minimal()
```
